title: 扫描地质图到可编辑 MapGIS 工程和原生页面（后台 MCP）
execution: Agent selects explicit source windows, control points, ink roles and palette through public MCP calls. No foreground input or screen coordinate clicking is used.
scope: Actual 47958x47903 source handled through bounded windows; illustrative shared frame; 54 source-color regions, contacts, 10 custom mineral points, 4 source attitude symbols/literal labels, native save/reopen/output and real parent-loss recovery. Ground accuracy and automatic geological interpretation are separate.

steps.action: Keep originals, retain source/preview offsets, and select the necessary resolution. A reduced preview is not full-resolution digitization; use overlapping windows and explicit cores when detail is required.
Use explicit real control and independent check points, or label a user-authorized illustrative frame. SIFT/RANSAC image check points share model selection and do not prove ground accuracy.
Import TIFF to native MSI with explicit GCPs and the complete source-member hash set. Verify a new native process reads all pixels/GCPs. GCP persistence does not itself rectify pixels.

Use source-reviewed RGB classes, explicit mineral/text occlusion polygons, fill limits and protected narrow bodies. Track source strokes by RGB/width and anchors; stop at real branches or equal routes. Retreat by submitting revised anchors under a new request. Never infer a fault solely because a stroke is red.

Create WT/WL/WP on the shared frame, then native-save and reopen every layer. Preserve region/attribute identities, holes, shared arcs and open intrusions. Native arc/node edits use the existing buffer API.

Separate boundary and protected/open roles. topology.trim_dangles nodes lines and removes bounded complete leaf branches in one pass; polygonize separately. Assign source classes by verified ownership, keep unclassified gap faces explicit, and compare coverage before native WP creation.

Create source-matched symbols and an explicit color branch; do not alter installed Slib. Join a fingerprint-bound XLSX stratum lookup onto existing native regions, then use style.classify with explicit number+100 fill-color mapping. Existing PCOLOR 3 KCMY records may be replaced, with spot/reserved bytes preserved. Use actual text font parameters and #+/#-/#= scripts. Preserve an ambiguous source label literally rather than invent its geological meaning.
Order MSI/areas/contacts/points/labels and bind project-owned libraries. Multi-layer selection and dirty checkpoints use revisions and stable request IDs. Full paths plus hashes distinguish projects.
先对同源、同调色板的全分辨率重叠窗口分别提取。以不重叠核心矩形指定归属，mapgis_merge_candidate_tiles 比较重叠颜色差异、裁去重复 halo、按类合并并检验共享覆盖；合并后统一配准。开放断层/保护线另行保留，不能加入造区候选后静默丢弃。原生图库接边模块是另一条需各自实测的路径。
checks: 接缝距离和重叠面积检查
跨块逻辑 ID 不冲突
原生合并后可独立编辑
steps.validation: FILE_TESTED: full course raster in two independent windows, core seam disagreement 0 px2; halo disagreement 2326 px2 recorded. Geological class identity and native library UI are not established by this check.

steps.action: Render native vectors, inspect the actual page, correct color/font errors, and export EPS/PDF/TIFF/JPEG. Also verify vectors independently of the background scan; a visible scan is not proof of digitized content.

Read the saved MPJ and dependencies in a fresh native PID. Verify geometry, attributes, text, native page environment and project-bound libraries after relocation. Agent-owned buffers are independent of another GUI editor.

On process/parent loss, recover durable checkpoints first; never resend an uncertain edit blindly. Verify geometry changed once, selection and dirty state survive, save/reopen, and close owned buffers after verification. External editors and arbitrary unsaved memory remain outside this owned context.

profile: Exact MapGIS 6.7 native build and per-call licence; isolated legacy compatibility opt-in
